per_boot_set.order: seeded shuffle per boot and arm (seed = 2610260 + boot); arm order seeded too; recorded in the queue log before the first trial

predictions.P-INV-1 (H1): usm_device bytes at u4 16,384 after turn 1 (gpu_mem_stats) are >= 15% higher at 74% than at 50%, in both ABAB pairs
predictions.P-INV-2 (H1 vs H2): raw allocate-until-failure ceiling (USM device, touched, 256 MiB chunks) at 74% >= its 50% value (H1). H2: it falls by more than 15%, or device USM fails before host USM
predictions.P-INV-3 (H1): llama.cpp (XRT-1 E2) ceiling is non-decreasing from 50% to 74%; H2: it also inverts (falls > 15%)
predictions.P-INV-4 (H3): a PINNED 1 GiB GPU balloon (kept resident by a 10 ms kernel) or a 2 GiB VirtualLock CPU balloon lowers the u4 hold count at 16,384 / 18,432 versus the same boot's unballooned trials (H3); H1 predicts no change, as with the idle balloons (598e882d, f9953743, 0014465c, 62d59ab8)
predictions.P-INV-5 (inversion reproduces): at u4 18,432 the two 50% boots hold >= 5 of 6 and the two 74% boots hold <= 1 of 6 (from L* 22,750 a2a7c763 vs 17,750 9e31d4cb); u4 16,384 and f16 4,096 / 6,144 hold at both settings (controls)
predictions.P-INV-6 (f16 collapse): f16 8,192 fails >= 2 of 3 in at least one 74% boot and holds >= 5 of 6 at 50%. If 8,192 holds at 74%, the 39d38c85 low-rung failure is read as a single-boot event (its loaded Available was 3,492 MB vs 7,150-8,061 MB in the other slider children)
predictions.P-INV-7 (H4): if boot variance explains the inversion, the 74/50 difference in hold counts changes sign between the two ABAB pairs
predictions.not_scheduled: f16 cap256 inversion within drift (from the plan's INV row): no INV-1 cell; scored only if a f16 cap256 cell runs at both settings

decision_rules.inconclusive: ceiling differences under 15% (raw allocation, llama.cpp, any L*) are inconclusive by rule
decision_rules.reproduced: P-INV-5 holds and one-sided Fisher exact p < 0.05 on the pooled u4 18,432 counts (50% vs 74%), with the same sign in each ABAB pair
decision_rules.mechanism_class: H1 if P-INV-1 and P-INV-2 hold; H2 if P-INV-2's H2 branch holds; H3 if P-INV-4 holds; Gate A (Wed Nov 4) decides
